statements.status_notes: The images ship tcpdump for packet capture and inspection. Crafted HNCP packet data or a malicious capture file may trigger an over-read in print_prefix in print-hncp.c. Debian tracks the finding as unfixed with unimportant urgency; applicability to the shipped parser and remediation remain under investigation. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2019-1010220
